samples.summary: User guide still documents API-key create/revoke as owner-only and claims Settings hides the section from members
samples.evidence: packages/documentation/guide/workspaces.md:42-43 role table: "See the list of API keys | Yes, but only via the CLI or REST API | Yes" and "Create or revoke an API key | No | Yes"; line 87 "**API Keys** — *owners only*"; line 90 "A member sees the first three sections and nothing below them"; lines 92-98 tip "creating and revoking are owner-only... it hides the whole **API Keys** section from anyone who isn't an owner, so a member has to use the CLI". After this change any member mints/revokes their own keys and workspace-settings.tsx renders the section unconditionally (packages/frontend/src/app/workspaces/workspace-settings.tsx:433), so every one of these statements is now wrong. packages/backend/README.md:673-677 was updated; this guide was not.

samples.summary: Developer REST docs state an API key is "minted by an owner" and may delete any document in its workspace
samples.evidence: packages/documentation/developers/rest-api.md:206: "An **API key** with the `write` scope may delete any document in its workspace — it is a workspace-scoped credential minted by an owner." With minting opened to members, a key can now carry only member authority, and packages/backend/src/api/v1/documents.controller.ts:188 resolves the minter's role at request time so a member-minted key deletes only documents that member manages. The public developer docs describe the old contract and would mislead an integrator sizing a key's blast radius.

samples.summary: Design-sandbox API-key fixture lacks the new `createdBy` field, so the owner-only "Created by" column renders "Unknown" in the visual scene
samples.evidence: FIXTURE_API_KEYS (packages/design-sandbox/src/scenes/fixtures/workspace.ts:42-50) carries only id/name/prefix/createdAt/lastUsedAt. The fixture user is seeded as `owner` (file header comment, line 5), so workspace-settings.tsx:475 calls `creatorName(apiKey.createdBy)` with `undefined`; `members.find` misses and the new column shows "Unknown" in the browser visual/interaction lane. The fixture is untyped, so nothing type-checks it either. Fix belongs in the fixture: add `createdBy: FIXTURE_USER.id` (and ideally a second key minted by member id 2).

samples.summary: `fetchApiKeys` mock has no resolved value but the query is now enabled in every render, including member-role cases
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/workspaces/__tests__/workspace-settings.test.tsx:26 mocks `fetchApiKeys: vi.fn()` with no `mockResolvedValue`; `renderAs` (line 69) only stubs fetchMe/fetchWorkspace/fetchInvites. Previously the api-keys query was gated on `isOwner` so it never ran in member-role tests; after the `enabled: !!workspaceId` change (workspace-settings.tsx:149) it runs in every test and the queryFn resolves `undefined`, which React Query v5 treats as an error. The component's `= []` default keeps assertions green, so this is noise rather than breakage, but the test file no longer exercises the api-keys path meaningfully.
